# BrixelLabs: Full-Stack Tech & AI Solutions

> Design · Build · Automate. Custom AI models, scalable web/mobile apps, computer vision systems, and enterprise workflow automation.

BrixelLabs is an independent engineering and AI studio that partners with high-growth startups and established enterprises. We build production-ready digital architectures spanning UI/UX design, full-stack web and mobile development, custom deep learning models (YOLO, PyTorch, TensorRT), LangGraph multi-agent systems, and real-time business telemetry.

For full detailed technical documentation and system architecture specifications, see:
- [Full Documentation](https://brixellabs.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive system specifications, model benchmarks, and production case studies.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Shopify Development](https://brixellabs.com/services/shopify-development): High-converting custom Shopify stores, Liquid theme engineering, headless Hydrogen commerce, sub-second load times, and custom checkout apps.
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://brixellabs.com/services/ai-chatbots): Production-ready AI chatbots for WhatsApp, Telegram, and web with verified document RAG, sub-second replies, and human agent handover.
- [Computer Vision Solutions](https://brixellabs.com/services/computer-vision): Industrial computer vision systems, sub-14ms defect detection, YOLOv8/YOLOv9 object tracking, edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson, and automated visual QA.
- [Web Development](https://brixellabs.com/services/web-development): Scalable React, Next.js, Django, Node.js microservices, distributed PostgreSQL databases, and Redis caching.
- [Autonomous AI Agents](https://brixellabs.com/services/ai-agents): Stateful LangGraph multi-agent workflows, autonomous tool-calling loops, custom CRM/ERP connectors, self-operating task queues, and intelligent business process automations.
- [Enterprise Web Scraping](https://brixellabs.com/services/web-scraping): Industrial web scraping clusters, Playwright/Scrapy automation, Cloudflare Turnstile bypass, rotating proxy pools, and structured ETL database loading.
- [Mobile App Development](https://brixellabs.com/services/mobile-development): High-performance native and cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter and React Native with 60 FPS animations.
- [API Development & Integration](https://brixellabs.com/services/api-development): High-throughput REST & GraphQL APIs, secure database connectors, and seamless integration into existing legacy or modern systems.
- [UI/UX Design & Prototypes](https://brixellabs.com/services/ui-ux-design): User research, interactive wireframing, high-fidelity Figma prototypes, and design token systems.
- [Custom Software & SaaS Development](https://brixellabs.com/services/custom-software): Bespoke custom software engineering, multi-tenant cloud SaaS architectures, and enterprise business tools.
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://brixellabs.com/services/machine-learning): Custom deep neural networks, predictive intelligence, neural classification, and automated model retraining pipelines.
- [Data Analytics & Dashboards](https://brixellabs.com/services/data-analytics): Advanced statistical modeling and executive BI dashboards built through Python (Pandas/NumPy), SQL, and Microsoft Excel.

## Verified Production Case Studies

- [Noesis: AI Study Assistant](https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/noesis): Stateful multi-agent study platform built on LangGraph, Groq LLaMA 3.3 70B, and Streamlit, featuring real-time web research, adaptive note synthesis, and calibrated MCQs with Human-in-the-Loop interrupts.
- [The Watcher: AI Child Safety Platform](https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/the-watcher): Intelligent parental safety mobile app combining Flutter, Kotlin background daemons, real-time ML activity classification, and LangGraph contextual alerts.
- [FrontDesk AI: Autonomous WhatsApp Booking Agent](https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/frontdesk-ai): Conversational AI managing appointment scheduling, calendar negotiation, and customer FAQs in Roman Urdu and English via WhatsApp API with <0.8s response latency.
- [ThreadEye: Industrial Fabric Defect Detection](https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/threadeye): Computer vision inspection system powered by YOLOv8n-seg and TensorRT running on NVIDIA Jetson edge hardware, detecting weave flaws with 99.8% accuracy at <14ms latency.
- [GetScry: Real-Time Visitor Intent Intelligence](https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/getscry): E-commerce predictive intelligence system using XGBoost and SHAP explainability to predict purchase intent in sub-35ms.

## Engineering Process

1. **Discover & Scope (1-3 days)**: Architecture mapping, requirements brief, and milestone roadmapping.
2. **Design & Prototype (3-7 days)**: Interactive UI prototypes, DB schemas, API contracts, and AI benchmark criteria.
3. **Build & Train (1-4 weeks)**: Full-stack development, continuous model evaluation, and weekly sprint demos.
4. **Launch & 24/7 SLA (Ongoing)**: Zero-downtime CI/CD deployment, error monitoring, and 99.99% uptime guarantee.
